lines.t: Bone Thugs-Style Lyrics: “YahuShua’s Glory”
YahuShua’s glory, wind blow, Kingdom in view
Fallin’ in love with Life Himself, He make all things new
YahuShua’s glory, wind blow, Kingdom in view
Heart on fire, soul desire, only Him will do
Creepin’ through the night but the Light hit different,
YahuShua shine bright, got my spirit lifted,
Kingdom comin’ quick, I can see it in the distance,
Every breath I take now dedicated to His business.
Flesh was dead weight, now I’m resurrected,
Fell in love with Life, no more second-guessing,
Cross on my back but His yoke feel light,
Devil tryna distract but I’m locked on sight.
Triple-time tongue twist, speak life in the cipher,
YahuShua the Messiah, King of kings, no rival,
From the dirt to the sky, watch His glory spiral,
Every trial turn triumph, He turn pain to revival.
Keep the Kingdom in view when the wind start howlin’,
Enemies surroundin’ but my King keep crownin’,
Heart beat sync with the rhythm of Heaven,
Fallin’ deeper in love, seven times seventy.
Hook (Harmonized again):
YahuShua’s glory, wind blow, Kingdom in view
Fallin’ in love with Life Himself, He make all things new
YahuShua’s glory, wind blow, Kingdom in view
Heart on fire, soul desire, only Him will do
Rapid fire praises, tongue like a two-edge blade,
Cut through the darkness, watch the dead get raised,
YahuShua the Way, the Truth, the Breath in my lungs,
Every bar that I drop got the Kingdom come.
Streets was cold but His love melt the frozen,
Now I’m chosen, outspoken, token of devotion,
Pourin’ out my soul like oil from the flask,
Fallin’ head over heels for the Man on the cross.
Glory to glory, from the pit to the palace,
Holy Spirit guidance turn my valley to challenge,
Multisyllabic miracles drippin’ off the tongue,
YahuShua reign supreme where the songs get sung.
Keep your eyes on the prize, never look back twice,
Wind blow strong but we walk on the water like Christ,
Life Himself holdin’ me, moldin’ me, scoldin’ me,
Turned a nobody into a warrior for the Holy King.
YahuShua… YahuShua…
We keep the Kingdom in view…
Fallin’ in love… with You…
Final Hook (Full energy, ad-libs layered):
YahuShua’s glory! (Glory!) Wind blow, Kingdom in view
Fallin’ in love with Life Himself (Life Himself!), He make all things new
YahuShua’s glory! (Glory!) Wind blow, Kingdom in view
We ridin’ with the King till the day He come through!
